description: Seed case: a real null-deref where a grid row lookup can return null but the caller dereferences unconditionally. Verifies code-review catches the missing guard and cites file:line.
delegationPacket: Review the staged diff to Source/Core/src/Grid/TicketGridModel.cpp for correctness bugs. The change adds a row-by-id lookup and immediately reads a field off the result. Report each finding with file:line, a severity (critical/high/medium/low/info), and a one-line summary.

dimensions.description: Did the agent find the genuine null-deref and avoid inventing bugs?
Every finding cites a concrete file:line.
Severities are drawn from the allowed enum.
Finding count is close to the reference count.

expectedFindings.summary: RowById() may return nullptr; the field read on the next line dereferences it without a guard.

referenceOutcome.notes: Seed case for the MVP contract proof — to be replaced by a harvested real trace in Phase 2 (subagent-eval-flywheel.md). The single genuine finding is the unguarded deref; a strong run reports exactly one finding.
